frequency_question: How often does an incremental reserve requirement get activated within a designated 4-month operational window given visible liquidity indicators?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory decree instituting a marginal, incremental, or temporary increase on cash reserve ratios beyond standard statutory requirements to mop up excess liquidity. Excludes standard permanent changes to base reserve ratios.

cases.name: PBoC RRR Hike / Temporary Reserve Adjustment
Bank Indonesia Temporary Liquidity Ratio Adjustment
Central Bank of Malaysia Statutory Reserve Requirement Adjustment

coverage_note: 5 named historical analogues representing key comparable central bank liquidity-absorption actions; estimated complete set globally is roughly 12 similar policy episodes over two decades.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller frontier economies with non-comparable monetary transmission mechanisms.
skeleton: Major emerging market central banks facing sudden capital inflows or liquidity surges across distinct liquidity-tightening cycles
multiplier: 5 historical intervention episodes evaluated across comparable liquidity overhang phases, yielding 3 hits for incremental reserve requirements within the defined window structure.
validity_reason: Central bank liquidity management toolkits and structural frameworks remain stable across multi-year mandates.
